title: Notification that bwatch finished processing a block
description: The **bwatch_block_processed** notification is sent during normal forward chain processing after `bwatch` has persisted a block and emitted every `bwatch_match` notification found while scanning it.
It provides a block-level completion boundary. Subscribers can process pending work once per block rather than registering a separate blockdepth watch for each match.
Registration-time historical rescans do not emit this notification for each revisited block; successful completion of the add-watch RPC is the rescan boundary.
Subscribers should handle a repeated notification idempotently after process recovery.
The height of the processed block.
The hash of the processed block.
